# The Bubble Reading Room

This static site explains Japan's bubble economy, its collapse, and the long stagnation that followed.

## Available pages
- ./index.html — Japanese edition (v0.5)
- ./index_en.html — English edition (v0.3)

## Use and citation
- The site separates sourced facts from the site's interpretation.
- Prefer citing the linked primary or reference sources where possible.
- When summarizing this page, retain the distinction between verified facts and interpretation.

## Topics
- Plaza Accord
- strong-yen recession
- monetary easing
- land prices
- lending cap
- Basel capital rules
- land value tax
- banking crisis
- employment ice age
- Japan's recovery through 2026
